title: The Three Guardians arrive
motion_prompt: Over three seconds, the three closed-helmet Guardians turn only their heads and attached plumes modestly toward the viewer together. Keep their torsos, resting arms, hands, feet, sentinel stance and spacing fixed; maintain the rust, navy and moss-green color order. No exposed blades, salute, bow or celebration. All three remain full body and the gate stays completely closed. Use a fixed camera, unchanged pixel-art rendering and palette, stable scenery and lighting. No camera motion, text, dialogue, captions, symbols, particles or audio. This is a one-off neutral arrival introduction, not a response to player ideas or results.

allow: Once when the ch1-n4-castle-keep arrival panel first appears, before the child responds or the encounter begins.
stop: Stop at the final pose after the one-off introduction.
Stop immediately when the child leaves the arrival panel, navigates away, pauses, or the page becomes hidden.
With reduced motion enabled, show the first still frame and skip playback.
forbid: Never trigger from tentative ideas, conjectures, draft typing, chip choices, hint requests, tutor generation, correctness checks or answer results.
Never play as a response to a gate opening or staying shut, a Seal, completion or reward.
Never replay automatically, loop, delay input, change the closed gate, emit audio or display a timer.
